svg.title: Two narrow local information contours coexist with two distant profile minima; the contours are not global confidence sets.
svg.desc: At a midpoint sensor, both separated source locations have nonsingular local Fisher information for unknown (A,a) with D=0.05 and eight fixed times. The upper contours show unit local information geometry, not calibrated global confidence regions. The lower plot profiles A in [0.7,1.3] for noiseless data from a=0.23. Midpoint sampling retains both minima; displacement to 0.49 removes this particular mirror fit. Symlog displays zero without adding an artificial positive residual.
